fields.Review:
I’ve been using the Salming Q1 Icon for a while now, and honestly it fits my game really well as a back. I’m mostly defensive, but when I get the chance to step up and shoot, this stick really delivers.

The first thing I noticed was how solid and reliable it feels. As a defender, I need good control when receiving passes under pressure and clearing the ball, and the Q1 blade gives me that. It doesn’t feel too soft or too jumpy, so passes are easy to control and I don’t lose the ball in tight situations.

When it comes to shooting, this stick is a weapon. I like to take hard slap shots and quick wrist shots from distance, and the shaft gives a nice snap when you load it. Shots feel powerful and accurate, especially when stepping into space at the top of the zone. It’s not just a shooting stick though — I can still keep the ball close when moving forward and joining the offense.

Defensively, the stick feels strong in duels. It doesn’t twist much when battling for the ball, and poke checks feel precise. I also like that the Q1 blade isn’t extreme — it’s predictable, which is important when you’re the last man back and can’t afford mistakes.

One thing to keep in mind is that it’s not a super flashy stick. If you’re all about tricks or crazy blade curves, this probably isn’t for you. But if you want something that works everywhere on the court, it’s perfect.

Overall, I’d say the Salming Q1 Icon is a great stick for a defender who shoots hard and isn’t afraid to push forward. It gives you confidence at the back and power when you decide to attack. Solid, dependable, and made for serious play.
fields.Headline: The best stick out there.

This stick is super lightweight and feels great in the hands, especially for its price. It’s easy to control and very playful, making dribbling smooth and effortless. The balance helps with quick moves and confident ball handling.
Passing is a strong point – the stick allows for fast, accurate, and powerful passes without much effort. It also feels quiet on the ball, giving you good touch and control in every situation.
Overall, it’s a great value stick for players who want something light, easy to handle, and fun to play with. Perfect for fast-paced, technical play.

fields.Review:
This is a great stick for players that like having control of the ball. 
You get really soft touches and for me as a playmaker it’s really important to be able to make sure the ball sticks to the blade well. The shooting is great. Sweepershots are the best shooting technique for this stick as it’s really light weight. The direct shots are good but maybe not the greatest shots.
The passing feels really good. And although it depends on your skills and hook it can still get great passes. Both in the air and on the ground. 
The dribbling is probably the best part. 
Because of the slim shaft it’s really easy to feel the ball, you get to have the ball stick to your blade. And quick direction changes are really easy, since the overall stick is lightweight.
